parameters.content:
## Spintax cold-email bridge — unique copy per lead (and per product)

### How it works

1. Sending platforms parse flat `{a|b|c}` at best, so this flow renders the full syntax first and hands your sender finished text.
2. Lead rows come in, and every top-level field of a row becomes a `%variable%` the template can address.
3. Each lead gets its own subject and body drawn from one template — no model call and no per-lead copywriting.
4. The flow ends at a placeholder node where your own sending integration connects.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Install the community node `n8n-nodes-spintax`.
- [ ] Replace **Load Sample Leads** with your real source.
- [ ] Edit the templates in the two Spintax nodes to match your offer.
- [ ] Swap the placeholder for your sending node and run it.

### Customization

Post-processing is on, so spacing and capitalisation come out clean after a variable drops in. Turn on Protect Placeholders if your sender injects its own `{{ }}` merge tags and you want them left untouched.

## Start and load leads

The sample code node stands in for your real source — a CRM, a sheet or a database query. Every top-level field of a row becomes a `%variable%`.

## Render, then hand off to your sender

Two Spintax nodes render one unique subject and body per lead: conditionals switch copy on a data field, plurals keep counts grammatical. Replace the pass-through with your sending node — it receives finished text, so nothing downstream understands spintax.
